description: Gate splitter, 6HP: each gate goes to one of two outputs according to whether its pitch is above or below a split point, channel by channel on a polyphonic cable

params.text: Shows the split point on the display as a voltage or as a note name

inputs.text: The pitch that each gate is judged by, at 1V per octave; on a polyphonic cable each channel is compared with the split point separately
The gates to be split; each channel goes to one output or the other according to the pitch on the matching channel of the CV input
A voltage added to the split point knob, the total clamped to the range -10V to 10V

outputs.text: Carries that channel's gate when its pitch is below the split point, and 0V otherwise
Carries that channel's gate when its pitch is at or above the split point, and 0V otherwise
Passes the CV input through unchanged; chaining a second Part from here rather than from the source keeps the gate and CV delays matched

menu: Apply -1mV epsilon to split point — on by default, takes 1mV off the split point so that small imprecisions in the incoming levels do not throw a note to the wrong side
Sharp (unchecked is flat) — picks whether the display spells the split point with sharps or with flats
Show +/- for notes — adds a plus or a minus to the note on the display when the split point is above or below that note rather than on it
